title: Rabbi Levi bar Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 64a he says: “One who leaves the synagogue, enters the study house and studies Torah merits receiving the Divine Presence,” as in “They go from strength,” etc. The saying also appears at the end of Moed Katan with the unqualified Rabbi Levi, but Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Levi bar Chiyyata.
And in Bereshit Rabbah 13:3: Rabbi Levi bar Ḥiyya said, And the three of them are from three letters, etc.
And in Shemot Rabbah 23:3, a fine parable from him.
And likewise a homily from him is found in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12.

notes.text: Hyman reports Chiyyata as a variant for Chiyya. “A fine parable from him” does not compare it with someone else’s parable.

Berakhot 64a directly names Levi bar Chiyya. The exact Dikdukei Soferim form Chiyyata and the remaining Midrash locators are Hyman’s reports; this comparison does not establish a canonical identity between the forms.
